name: ast-ai-model-router
description: AST-based Claude Code and Codex model routing with token-cost estimates and CI policy checks.

interface.shortDescription: Pick Claude Code or Codex models from AST, task, cost, and policy signals.
interface.longDescription: AST AI Model Router analyzes JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python project structure plus the current task to choose an appropriate Claude Code or Codex model before launch. It adds Tokenometer-backed token-cost estimates, explainable decision records, and CI policy checks for teams. It is part of the faraa2m token-economics toolkit for measuring, reducing, and routing LLM spend.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this repo and choose the right Codex model.
Route this Claude Code task by AST complexity.
Explain why this coding task needs a stronger model.
